focus_areas: Legibility and structure of the front fender text/logo.
Straightness of body lines (especially the beltline and roof edge).
Wheel geometry and tire contact patch with the ground.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'uncanny valley' effect of the side windows; real glass usually has some specular highlight or interior visibility even when tinted. Verify if the sliding door track aligns perfectly with the door handle. Crucially, use the image_text_auditor results to determine if the blue logo on the fender is genuine branding or AI-generated gibberish, as this is a high-risk failure mode.
image_description: A white minibus (resembling a Fiat Ducato or similar high-roof van chassis) parked on a paved surface, viewed from the front-three-quarter angle. The vehicle features a high roofline, a large windshield, a visible sliding door track and handle on the side, black lower body cladding, and a blue logo/text graphic on the front fender. The background consists of a corrugated metal wall and some greenery.
